scope.check: for each trace, run it live through GameEngine.step(char), then persist the recorded CommandHistory via SaveGameRepository, reload it, and replay the saved characters through a fresh World/GameEngine pair using the same GameEngine.step(char) entry point; compare a canonical state string (player position, health, money, invincibility, remaining coins, full tile grid) between the live and replayed runs

cases: shortest path through a single-gap wall has the expected length and is all axis-adjacent steps
identical calls return identical paths (deterministic reconstruction)
restoring undoes health and position changes
restoring brings back a collected coin (grid tile AND the interactables map entry)
mutating the grid after a checkpoint does not affect the saved snapshot (defensive copy)

aggregate.command: java -cp <library-sp26 jars>;out;out-test org.junit.runner.JUnitCore core.ReplayEquivalenceTest core.BfsPathfinderTest core.CheckpointTest
